name: Fostoria
isnote: Recovered in Rhabdodontomorpha by a 2020 analysis (as reported for that clade on English Wikipedia) but assigned to Elasmaria in PBDB; placed directly in Ornithopoda.
sum: An iguanodontian ornithopod from the mid-Cretaceous Griman Creek Formation of Lightning Ridge, New South Wales, Australia.
